release_notes:
🚀 UPDATE V1.2.14+46: ACCURACY DASHBOARD TYPOGRAPHY FIX
• The 'Next Scheduled' and 'Last Auto Analysis' dates in the accuracy dashboard are now fully formatted as readable strings (e.g. 'Mar 4, 1:00 AM') instead of ambiguous numbers (e.g. '4/3 0:00') that were being mistaken for statistical ratios.
• This update includes the new 01:00 AM verification schedule.
• Strict Date Formatting: The prediction AI now strictly adheres to theory-derived single YYYY-MM-DD impact dates without fail.
• Search Fallback Hardening: Integrated Yahoo Finance autocomplete as the primary backup mechanism, boosting stock scraping success rates during DuckDuckGo rate-limits.
